purpose: Machine-readable semantic profile for the MNSTRY Atelier Kit to keep local Git/source vocabulary distinct from MNSTRY runtime authority vocabulary.

authorityPrinciples.statement: Git repository access is the hard read boundary for source files. Local audience labels and projection gates do not make a file secret from anyone who can clone or read the repository.
The word visibility is reserved for the MNSTRY runtime enum and for export artifacts that intentionally carry runtime visibility values.

Local documentation and corpus classification use audience for intended readership/projection eligibility. Audience is not runtime visibility and is not a security boundary inside a readable Git repository.
The first runtime consumer of this profile is the atelier-export@v1 dry-run importer. Until that importer exists, activation claims remain contract-level and fixture-level only.

audience.description: Intended local readership and projection eligibility for Atelier source documents.
audience.defaultPolicy: fail-closed; unclassified content must not project publicly
notes: A private or sensitive audience value does not hide a file from users with Git repository access.
Projection gates may consume audience, but repository permissions remain the read boundary.

visibility.description: Runtime visibility enum on governed MNSTRY objects.

runtimeReferences.notes: Core object visibility constraints and default private posture.

notes: Use this word locally only when representing a runtime/export value verbatim.
Do not use runtime visibility values to describe source-document readership unless the document is an export fixture or dry-run object.

repo_access.description: Actual read/write access to the Git repository or path substrate.
notes: For source files, repo_access determines who can read the material.
Projection labels cannot reduce access for users who already have repository read permissions.

git.promote.description: A durable disclosure event that moves or copies source material into a broader Git-readable or projection-eligible container.
notes: A git.promote event may be homologous to runtime resource sharing, but it is not a runtime provision.
Undoing promotion requires a new Git history event and cannot guarantee unread by previous readers.

provision.description: Runtime resource-shared-into-space grant, not a local Git disclosure event.

runtimeReferences.notes: space.provisions resource sharing table and validation trigger.

notes: Use git.promote for local durable disclosure.

sensitivity.description: Local handling risk classification for source documents and generated projections.
notes: Runtime data_boundary remains reserved for space descriptors using runtime enum values.
Use sensitivity for local document handling until a runtime import object requires data_boundary.

runtimeReferences.notes: space.spaces data_boundary values and cross-ministry membership guard.

notes: Do not attach runtime data_boundary values to arbitrary source documents unless the object is a runtime space descriptor or export fixture.

egress_intent.description: Local declaration of intended provider/model/data egress posture before runtime enforcement exists.
notes: provider_egress is not a verified runtime canonical today.
Runtime provider controls must be represented by explicit runtime import fields when they exist.

runtime_object.description: Local pointer to a real runtime table/object family.
notes: semantic_object is not a verified runtime canonical.
Team architecture documents should not default to core.artifact without an explicit personal-actor-content rationale.

mustNotAnalyzeOrGovern: bookings, payments, refunds, or commerce truth
analysis.modelProviderPolicy: Analysis must run through the active agentic harness and must not introduce a hidden model provider, second API key, or second inference boundary.
analysis.promotionRule: Analysis suggestions become canonical only after reviewed promotion into source front matter or a governed runtime import path.

sourceValidation.description: build-knowledge-graph.mjs validates mandatory kg.audience, rejects legacy kg.visibility, and checks declared graph relations.

projectionGate.description: projection-policy.mjs gates public/team/operator/local graph, alignment, API, and export source eligibility.

atelierExportV1.description: contracts:check resolves sourceRefs/sourceNodes against the Atelier knowledge graph and fails public objects with non-public source kgIds.

runtimeDryRunImporter.description: MNSTRY runtime worktree provides a non-mutating atelier-export@v1 dry-run validator for enum/classification alignment.
